work: Daejeon Hoetong, Book of Rites: succession, adoption, marriage, mourning
heading: 大典會通 禮典 · 婚嫁 혼가 · Marriage … 大典會通 婚嫁 12

items.text: Do not give a son in marriage before he is fifteen or a daughter before she is fourteen; you may discuss a match at thirteen, and only with official approval may you marry off a child of twelve or older because a parent is chronically ill or fifty.
items.quote: 男年十五, 女年十四, 方許婚嫁 — A son at fifteen, a daughter at fourteen, only then are they permitted to marry.

items.text: If your wife dies, wait three years before taking another wife; if your parents command it or you are over forty and without a son, you may remarry after one year.
items.quote: 士大夫妻亡者, 三年後改娶 — If a scholar-official's wife dies, remarry after three years.

items.text: After the wedding, go to your husband’s parents with the prescribed wine and food, in token of respect.
items.quote: 新婦謁舅姑, 酒一盆, 肴饌五器 — The new bride visits her husband’s parents with one basin of wine and five dishes of food.

items.text: If a parent of either family dies after the betrothal gifts have been sent, wait three years before holding the wedding.
items.quote: 前期納幣之後, 雖有兩家父母喪, 亦待三年 — After the betrothal gifts have been sent, even if there is mourning for the parents of either family, wait three years.

items.text: Do not marry someone whose surname is the same as yours, even if his or her ancestral seat is different.
items.quote: 鄕貫雖異, 姓字若同, 則毋得婚娶 — Though the clan seat differ, if the surname is the same, you must not marry.
items.conflict: Scripture forbids marriage only within close blood relations, not everyone of one surname.

items.text: Do not hold your wedding while the one-year mourning for a parent or elder is still incomplete.
items.quote: 身在喪中, 子之朞服未盡, 而徑行婚禮者, 以不謹居喪律論 — If one is in mourning and the son’s one-year mourning is not complete, and he hastily holds the wedding, punish him for careless mourning.

items.text: Do not divorce or separate from your wife merely because she is the granddaughter of a traitor.
items.quote: 逆家孫女, 勿令離異 — For the granddaughter of a rebel family, do not cause separation.

work: Daejeon Hoetong, Book of Rites: succession, adoption, marriage, mourning
heading: 大典會通 禮典 · 五服 오복 · The Five Mourning Grades · 大典會通 五服 7 … 大典會通 五服 8

items.text: Mourn a child who dies young according to the grade: from ages 16 to 19 in the nine-month grade, from 12 to 15 in the five-month grade, and from 8 to 11 in the three-month grade.
items.quote: 子, 長殤大功, 中殤小功, 下殤緦麻 — A child: long premature death, nine months; middle, five months; lower, three months.

items.text: Mourn a grandchild who dies young: the eldest grandson in the same grades as a child, other grandsons in the five-month and three-month grades, and great-grandchildren and great-great-grandchildren in the three-month grade.
items.quote: 嫡孫, 長殤大功, 中殤小功, 下殤緦麻 — Heir grandson: long premature death, nine months; middle, five months; lower, three months.

items.text: Mourn a brother or sister who dies young according to the grade: long in nine months, middle in five months, lower in three months.
items.quote: 兄弟, 姊妹, 長殤大功, 中殤小功, 下殤緦麻 — Brothers and sisters: long, nine months; middle, five months; lower, three months.

items.text: Mourn a father's brother or sister who dies young according to the grade: long in nine months, middle in five months, lower in three months; if the father's sister had married out, all three grades are three months.
items.quote: 伯·叔父, 長殤大功, 中殤小功, 下殤緦麻 — Father's brother: long, nine months; middle, five; lower, three.

items.text: Mourn a nephew or niece who dies young according to the grade: long in nine months, middle in five months, lower in three months.
items.quote: 姪及姪女, 長殤大功, 中殤小功, 下殤緦麻 — Nephews and nieces: long, nine months; middle, five; lower, three.

items.text: Mourn a paternal cousin or a father's cousin who dies young in the three-month grade.
items.quote: 堂兄弟, 長殤緦麻。 堂姊妹, 長殤緦麻 — Paternal cousins: long premature death, three months.

items.text: Mourn her father and mother for one year.
items.quote: 父母, 期年 — Father and mother: one year.

items.text: Mourn her grandparents for one year, her great-grandparents for five months, and her great-great-grandparents for three months.
items.quote: 祖父母, 期年, 曾祖父母, 齊衰五月, 高祖父母, 齊衰三月 — Grandparents: one year; great-grandparents: five months; great-great-grandparents: three months.

items.text: Mourn her brothers and sisters in the nine-month grade; if her husband has died and she has no son, in the year grade without staff.
items.quote: 兄弟, 大功,(若夫亡無子, 則不杖期。) 姊妹, 大功,(若夫亡無子, 則不杖期。) — Brothers and sisters: nine months; if husband dead and no child, year without staff.

items.text: Mourn her father's brothers and their wives, and her father's sisters, in the nine-month grade.
items.quote: 伯·叔父母, 大功, 姑, 大功 — Father's brothers and their wives, and father's sisters: nine months.
items.needs_role: father's brother and wife; father's sister

items.text: Mourn her nephews and nieces in the nine-month grade.
items.quote: 姪及姪女, 大功 — Nephews and nieces: nine months.

items.text: Mourn her paternal cousins in the five-month grade, and her paternal granduncles and aunts, father's cousins, and first cousins once removed in the three-month grade.
items.quote: 堂兄弟, 小功, 堂姊妹, 小功 — Paternal cousins: five months.
items.needs_role: paternal cousins; paternal granduncles/aunts; father's cousins; first cousins once removed

work: Daejeon Hoetong, Book of Rites: succession, adoption, marriage, mourning
heading: 大典會通 禮典 · 立後 입후 · Adoption of an Heir … 大典會通 立後 7

items.text: Report to the magistrate and adopt a younger son of the same clan as your heir if neither your wife nor your concubine has borne a son.
items.quote: 嫡·妾俱無子者告官, 立同宗支子爲後 — If neither wife nor concubine has a son, report to the magistrate and adopt a same-clan younger son as heir.

items.text: Join the other father in consenting to your son's adoption as another house's heir; if the father is dead, let the mother report it to the magistrate.
items.quote: 兩家父同命立之, 父歿, 則母告官 — The two fathers together order the adoption; if the father is dead, the mother reports to the magistrate.

items.text: If your birth parents have no other heir, end the adoption and return to your original family.
items.quote: 爲人後者, 本生父母絶嗣, 則罷繼歸宗 — A man adopted as heir, when his birth parents have no heir, ends the adoption and returns to his original family.

items.text: If your adoptive parents are dead and no replacement heir can be set up, keep their spirit tablets as an attached ancestor so their rites do not cease.
items.quote: 若所後父母已死不得改立後, 則從旁親班祔例, 權奉其神主, 俾不絶祀 — If the adoptive parents have died and no new heir can be set up, keep their spirit tablets so their rites do not cease.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment and the worship of God alone.

items.text: Do not take a second wife; if you have no son, adopt a same-clan younger son as your heir.
items.quote: 駙馬無子者, 同宗支子, 立以爲後, 勿令再娶 — A prince consort without a son: adopt a same-clan younger son as heir, and do not let him remarry.
items.conflict: Scripture allows a widower to remarry (1 Cor 7:39); this rule forbids a royal son-in-law from remarrying.

work: Daejeon Hoetong, Book of Rites: succession, adoption, marriage, mourning
heading: 大典會通 禮典 · 奉祀 봉사 · Ancestral Rites and the Ritual Heir … 大典會通 奉祀 5

items.text: As the ritual heir, offer the ancestral rites to the departed ancestors of the required generations according to your station; if your rank is lower than a branch descendant's, follow the branch descendant's generation count.
items.quote: 文武官六品以上, 祭三代, 七品以下, 祭二代, 庶人, 則只祭考妣 — Civil and military officials of rank six and above sacrifice to three generations; rank seven and below to two; commoners only to father and mother.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment (Exodus 20:3-5); worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Do not remove an ancestor's tablet if he was the first meritorious subject, even when the generation limit is reached; set up a separate room for him.
items.quote: 始爲功臣者, 代雖盡, 不遷, 別立一室 — If he was the first meritorious subject, even when generations are exhausted, he is not removed; a separate room is set up.
items.conflict: Venerating a meritorious ancestor in a separate shrine conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: When the great-grandfather's generation is exhausted and is due to be removed, sacrifice to him at the home of your uncle whose mourning is not yet exhausted.
items.quote: 曾祖代盡當出, 則就伯·叔位服未盡者, 祭之 — When the great-grandfather's generation is exhausted and should be removed, sacrifice to him at the house of an uncle whose mourning is not exhausted.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; the dead cannot be worshiped or served (Deuteronomy 18:10-12).

items.text: Enshrine all the wives of a departed scholar-official together if he had two or more.
items.quote: 士大夫二妻以上, 竝祔 — If a scholar-official had two or more wives, enshrine them all together.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: As the next legitimate son, perform the ancestral rites when the eldest legitimate son has no heir.
items.quote: 嫡長子無後, 則衆子奉祀 — If the eldest legitimate son has no heir, the other legitimate son performs the ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: As a concubine's son, perform the ancestral rites when no legitimate son has an heir; if a commoner concubine's son has no heir, let a low-born concubine's son succeed.
items.quote: 衆子無後, 則妾子奉祀; 良妾子無後, 則賤妾子承重 — If the other legitimate son has no heir, a concubine's son performs the rites; if a commoner concubine's son has no heir, a low-born concubine's son succeeds.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; status distinctions in worship have no basis in Christ.

items.text: As a concubine's son who succeeds as ritual heir, sacrifice to your own mother in a private room, for your lifetime only.
items.quote: 凡妾子承重者, 祭其母於私室, 止其身 — Every concubine's son who succeeds sacrifices to his own mother in a private room, limited to himself.
items.conflict: Private ancestral sacrifice to one's own mother still conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).
items.needs_role: concubine's son who succeeds (妾子承重者)

items.text: Include collateral relatives who died without heirs in the ancestral sacrifices.
items.quote: 旁親之無後者, 祔祭 — Collateral relatives without heirs are offered attached sacrifice.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; the dead cannot be worshiped or served.

items.text: As the servant or tomb keeper appointed by a childless master, perform his ancestral rites according to the written contract.
items.quote: 士大夫無子女欲以奴婢·墓直主祭者...使奉其祀 — If a scholar-official has no children and wishes to use servants or tomb keepers to preside... have them perform the rites.
items.conflict: Using a servant to offer ancestral rites still conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

items.text: When another son is made ritual heir, do not treat the deceased eldest son's wife as the principal daughter-in-law.
items.quote: 長子死無後, 更立他子奉祀, 則長子之婦, 毋得以冢婦論 — If the eldest son dies without heir and another son is appointed to perform the rites, the eldest son's wife is not to be treated as the principal daughter-in-law.

items.text: As the ritual heir, preserve the ancestral shrine house, pass it to the next ritual heir, and do not sell it without authorization.
items.quote: 立廟家舍, 傳給於主祭子孫, 而擅賣者, 禁斷 — The shrine house is transmitted to the descendant who performs the rites, and unauthorized sale is prohibited.
items.conflict: Maintaining an ancestral shrine for the dead conflicts with the second commandment and Christ's exclusive mediation (1 Timothy 2:5).

items.text: As the adopted heir, perform the ancestral rites, even if a biological son is born later.
items.quote: 凡無子立後者...雖或生子, 當爲第二子, 以立後者奉祀 — Anyone who has adopted an heir... even if a son is born later, he becomes the second son, and the adopted son performs the rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; adoption should not carry a duty to worship the dead.

work: Daejeon Hoetong, Book of Rites: succession, adoption, marriage, mourning
heading: 大典會通 禮典 · 五服 오복 · The Five Mourning Grades … 大典會通 五服 6

items.text: Mourn your father with the deepest three-year unhemmed sackcloth mourning.
items.quote: 父, 斬衰三年 — Father: three years of unhemmed sackcloth.

items.text: Mourn your mother with three-year hempen mourning.
items.quote: 母, 齊衰三年 — Mother: three years of hempen mourning.

items.text: Mourn your grandparents for one year without the staff.
items.quote: 祖父母, 齊衰不杖期 — Grandparents: one year hempen without staff.

items.text: Mourn a son or daughter for one year.
items.quote: 子, 期年（女同） — Child: one year; daughters likewise.

items.text: Mourn a brother or sister for one year.
items.quote: 兄弟, 期年, 姊妹, 期年 — Brother: one year; sister: one year.

items.text: Mourn your wife for one year.
items.quote: 妻, 期年 — Wife: one year.

items.text: Mourn your husband with the deepest three-year unhemmed sackcloth mourning.
items.quote: 夫, 斬衰三年 — Husband: three years of unhemmed sackcloth.

items.text: Mourn your husband's father for three years and his mother for three years.
items.quote: 舅, 斬衰三年, 姑, 齊衰三年 — Father-in-law: three years; mother-in-law: three years.

items.text: Mourn your adoptive parents and their kin exactly as a natural child would.
items.quote: 爲人後者, 爲所後父母及內·外親, 竝如親子 — One made heir: for adoptive parents and kin, all as a natural child.

items.text: Mourn a married-out aunt, sister, daughter, or granddaughter one grade lower; if she has returned, treat her as unmarried.
items.quote: 爲出嫁女, 降本服一等, 姑·姊·妹·女·孫女嫁反者, 同未嫁 — For married-out women reduce one grade; aunt, sister, daughter, granddaughter who return are as unmarried.

items.text: During the three years of mourning, do not join in feasting or marry a wife or concubine.
items.quote: 三年內, 勿與宴樂·娶妻妾 — Within three years do not join in feasting or marry wife or concubine.

items.text: As a concubine, mourn the head of the house for three years and his wife for one year.
items.quote: 妾爲家長 夫, 斬衰三年, 父, 期年, 母, 期年, 女君, 期年, 子, 期年 — Concubine for the household head: master three years; father, mother, wife, child one year.
items.conflict: Conflicts with God's one-flesh monogamy (Gen 2:24; Matt 19:5).
